paragraphs: Rabbi Eliezer son of Rabbi Yishmael — [Tosefta Terumot 9:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosefta_Terumot.9.6).

Rabbi Yannai son of Rabbi Yishmael — [Avodah Zarah 30a](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.30a.4). Ulla son of Yishmael — [Sanhedrin 92a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.92a.2). Rava son of Yishmael — [Moed Katan 6b](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.6b.14).[^1]

notes.text: Moed Katan gives Rava bar Yishmael and Rav Yeimar bar Shelamya as alternative attributions. The list records the patronymic across separate passages.
